name: git-updater-install-stats
description: An add-on for Git Updater that loosely counts active installs per plugin or theme on your update server.

scripts.zip: wp-scripts plugin-zip && mkdir -p deploy && mv git-updater-install-stats.zip deploy/
scripts.release: npm run update-version && npm run build
scripts.betarelease: npm run update-version && npm run build
scripts.version: npm run update-version && git add git-updater-install-stats.php
scripts.build: composer install --no-interaction && npm run make-pot && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && npm run zip && composer install --no-interaction
